transcript.text: มีบางสิ่งบางอย่างทำให้ฉันรู้สึกสับสนในช่วงนี้ ไม่ ฉันไม่เป็นตัวของตัวเองอีกต่อไปแล้ว

translations.en: Something's been making me feel confused lately. No, I'm not myself anymore.
translations.ko: 요즘 뭔가 나를 혼란스럽게 해. 아니, 더 이상 예전의 내가 아닌 것 같아.

translations.id: Ada sesuatu yang membuatku merasa bingung akhir-akhir ini. Tidak, aku bukan diriku lagi.
translations.pt: Há algo me fazendo sentir confusa ultimamente. Não, eu não sou mais eu mesma.

translations.en: It's a feeling of being pressured in a tight space like the walls are closing in, struggling against internal challenges.
translations.ko: 벽이 조여오는 것처럼 좁은 곳에 갇힌 듯한 압박감이 들고, 내면의 나와 사투를 벌이고 있지.
translations.zh-TW: 那種感覺就像是被壓抑在狹小的空間裡，牆壁彷彿正在逼近，我必須與內心的挑戰搏鬥。
translations.id: Rasanya seperti tertekan di tempat sempit seolah dinding-dinding mendekat, dan harus berjuang melawan tantangan di dalam diri.
translations.pt: É uma sensação de pressão em um lugar apertado, como se as paredes estivessem se fechando, lutando contra desafios internos.

translations.en: It feels like losing my mind. How many times have I told you that I'm not good at being alone?

translations.id: Rasanya akal sehatku melayang pergi. Sudah berapa kali kukatakan padamu bahwa aku tidak pandai hidup dalam kesendirian?
translations.pt: É como se minha mente estivesse vagando. Quantas vezes te disse que não sou boa em ficar sozinha?

translations.en: Yes, loneliness makes me feel terrible. I've been trying so hard to cope with the mental pain and stress.
translations.ko: 그래, 외로움은 나를 너무 힘들게 해. 마음의 상처와 스트레스를 이겨내려고 애쓰고 있어.
